titulo: Pick a door: A or B? Cella won’t peek
caption:
Pick a door. Two shut doors, pink and violet, both knocking from the inside.
Cella stands between them and refuses to look.
Comment A or B. At 10 votes, the winner opens in the next Short.

alt: A 10-second vertical video with our own music and no voice. On a lime background, a pink door marked A and a violet door marked B shake as something knocks from inside, while Cella, a small dark door-shaped character with white eyes and a flat red crown, stands between them without peeking. Stickers read two doors, one opens; comment A or B; most votes opens next; she won’t peek.
comentario_fijado: One letter: A or B. At 10 votes, the winning door opens in the next Short. Under 10, both stay shut. She’s fine with that.
experimento_prueba: la audiencia elige el siguiente Short con un umbral público de 10 votos en el fijado; cuadro 0 sin texto (dos puertas que golpean). Votos válidos, vistas, suscriptores y visto medio en YouTube a 72 h
nota_junta: el fijado se actualiza a diario solo con cuentas reales; a 10 votos se hace el final ganador (A: una Cella pequeña lisa sin corona, 'WHO ARE YOU.'; B: cuarto vacío con taburete y lámpara, 'JUST A TUESDAY.') y sale en 48 h; bajo 10, 'Both doors stay shut. She's fine with that.'
